headline_note: The 12 weightiest of 19 contacts within 1.5° in the period, ranked by how slow the transiting planet is, how central the natal point is (Sun, Moon, Asc, MC and the chart ruler Jupiter count double) and the aspect. Positions are at the exact moment. 'passes' lists every exact moment of a contact's current run, in and out of the period (a retrograde loop's passes), and 'pass n of m' says which of them this is. 'exact' is the exact moment when it falls in the period; 'nearest_exact' is that moment, or otherwise the nearest one before or after the period, with 'movement' saying whether the orb closes (applying) or opens (separating) across the period.
